instruction: Can you open this streaming link in VLC? https://devstreaming-cdn.apple.com/videos/streaming/examples/bipbop_adv_example_hevc/master.m3u8

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation using Apple HEVC advanced example stream. Uses existing is_vlc_playing metric for URL verification. Same complexity as original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_vlc_playing_info) correctly fetches VLC status via HTTP interface and saves XML to file, returns None on HTTP failure
Metric (is_vlc_playing) has proper None check (lines 26-28) before opening file, preventing crashes on getter failure
Metric correctly verifies both: (1) VLC state is 'playing', and (2) expected URL matches the actual playing URL
URL matching logic is robust with multiple fallback strategies for HLS streams: direct match, filename match, domain/path comparison
Complete coverage: evaluator checks ALL requirements in instruction (VLC playing + correct URL loaded)
Expected parameter handling is CORRECT: metric receives rules dict directly as 'rule' parameter, accesses rule['type'] and rule['url'] without nesting
Edge case handling: Properly handles HTTP failures (None check), missing URL info (logs warning, returns 0), state mismatches (returns 0)
Semantic correctness: The getter extracts the RIGHT state (VLC playing status + URL info), metric compares the RIGHT aspects (state='playing' + URL match)
